hypothesis: Broad-market leadership candidates whose ticker reappears within 60 calendar days may carry continuation alpha, or may instead be crowded repeat exposure. A bounded notional scalar can test this state field without changing candidate eligibility.

identity_control.interpretation: The current local broad-market replay inputs must reproduce the accepted exp-20260520-004 artifact before any new notional scalar can be promoted. Drift blocks promotion even when a scout variant has positive aggregate metrics.

interpretation: The recent-repeat field is a real production-visible state field, but it is not a clean broad-market alpha on the frozen replay. Any positive aggregate variant must also clear the identity control before promotion.
known_risks: Historical replay depends on the local exp-20260519-030 warehouse.
The identity control is expected to block promotion if local replay does not reproduce exp-20260520-004 exactly.
The adjusted cohort is paper-only; forward paper evidence remains required before any trade-enabled adapter.

next_evidence_needed: Do not retry adjacent broad-market notional scalars on the same frozen replay until the broad-market identity-control drift is resolved or forward paper outcomes provide distinct replacement value.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: same-ticker repeats inside 60 calendar days may signal continuation or crowding for broad-market leadership candidates.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: State-surface recent-repeat was accepted, but broad-market price/rank/extension/volatility/trend/score experiments did not test same-ticker recurrence as its own field.
protocol_answers.3_single_variable: Only the recent-repeat notional scalar changes; lookback is fixed at 60 days and all selection, ranking, hold, slots, and universe controls stay fixed.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=6 targeted trades across all 3 windows, concentration guards, identity control, and <=0.5pp max drawdown worsening.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Script, JSON artifact, log, ticket, markdown artifact, and JSONL identify windows, parameters, and metrics.

rejection_reason: Best recent-repeat scalar failed Gate 4 or the broad-market identity control. No shared policy, sizing helper, production adapter, or live/default order path is changed.

shared_adapter_parity.reason: Gate 4 failed or identity control failed; no shared broad-market policy or production adapter change is retained.

single_causal_variable: same-ticker recent-repeat notional scalar for fixed broad-market selected candidates
